↗ prob:7-2 8-25. Prove that if $G$ is an abelian Lie group, then $\operatorname {Lie}\left( G\right)$ is abelian. [Hint: show that the inversion map $i : G \rightarrow G$ is a group homomorphism, and use Problem 7-2.] \end{exercise}
